evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: The 'we' enacts communal-sharing: a ratified collective decision, undifferentiated pooling of authority into one body.

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback framing is a proportionality design — cost/benefit tradeoff between blocking and non-blocking, framed as consequence-for-choice.
